electricityContract.terms: A copy of the Standard Retail Contract can be provided on request and can be seen on our website. Refer to https://www.actewagl.com.au/legal/pricing-information/your-rights-and-obligations.
electricityContract.variation: If we vary our standing offer prices, we will publish the notification of a variation in a newspaper and on our website at least 10 business days before it starts. We will also: notify you at least five business days before the variation in the standing offer prices or miscellaneous fees and charges are to apply to you; and deliver the notice by your preferred form of communication where you have communicated this to us, or otherwise by the same method as that used for delivery of your bill.

incentives.description: Free usage from 11am to 2pm daily for the first 24kWh. Charges apply for additional usage.

VPP add-on that allows customers to participate in VPP on current plan. Customers with a compatible battery can enrol. In return, customers receive a $60 quarterly credit ($0.597758 ex gst / day). Key details: Customers remain on current plan and covered under existing VPP Services Agreement. Eligibility: compatible battery needed - see website. Existing ActewAGL customers receive a $100 sign up bonus, and new ActewAGL customers receive a $200 sign up bonus. Call 02 5110 2528 for more details.

VPP add-on available only through Electrify with ActewAGL, for customers purchasing eligible batteries through approved installers. This is in addition to the Battery Power Top-Up. In return, customers receive a $20 quarterly credit ($0.1992528 ex gst /day). Key details: customers remain on current plan, $20 quarterly bill credit ($80/year) and covered under the existing VPP Services Agreement. Eligibility: Compatible battery (full list on website) purchased through Electrify with ActewAGL.
